objective: Determine whether originally source-locked release→final reported distance discordance is concentrated in predeclared nominal translocation classes or also in untranslocated controls; preserve original ecological STOP.

user_defined_treatment.reading: Numeric distance in meters rounded to 0, 100, 250 or 500 (per publisher README). Not a measured realized displacement for inferential scoring.
user_defined_treatment.direct_numeric_membership: numeric exactly equal 100,250,500; do not bin other values by nearest class

eligible_source_rows.original_165_source_rows: Read all original rows only after full original version/SHA/README checkpoint
eligible_source_rows.dedup: remove byte-identical duplicate rows exactly, retain repeated individual IDs
eligible_source_rows.rows_with_valid_id_and_reencounter_date_: same eligibility as prior v2 QC; report all excluded rows without outcome selection
eligible_source_rows.tolerance: original max(2m,5% computed), do not retune
eligible_source_rows.original_qualified_QC_denominator: 163, and each published channel compared on all 163 unless original missingness differs; preserve count

predeclared_outputs: For each of the five nominal categories: original/eligible rows, unique IDs, release-final and capture-final comparable count, matched count and fraction under frozen tolerance

Within nominal zero group: number with initial and release coordinates agreeing to within <=5 m (preexisting sham geometric threshold from original protocol) and number with capture-final and release-final reported fields agreeing under original frozen tolerance
Within nominal >0 classes: number with initial-release coordinate distance exceeding 5m; this is a metadata consistency diagnostic, not behavior
Per class: median and q90 absolute distance-column residual, only when n>=5 to prevent single-record leakage
Summation over classes must reproduce full existing 163-row baseline QC 77/163 release-final and 163/163 capture-final; if mismatch STOP
No source or destination coordinates, individual identifiers, dates, signed movement/homing values or per-row flags to output
forbidden: Do not repeat/override prior biological H1 or perform a source-anchor effect test
Do not use publication 104/61 counts to delete unmatched events
Do not correct the release-final distance column, choose a new coordinate pair or alter prior quality tolerance
Do not substitute nominal displacement for continuous release-final distance
Do not label a mismatched row biological migration, a founder error or wrong source
No additional EOG-WF scored endpoint; original 3/31/3 closure remains
